units.source_text: “如此严肃认真的内藏助，那时候还写过《花街小景》这样一首歌。

en.t: Even the solemn and earnest Kuranosuke wrote a song called Little Scenes of the Pleasure Quarter around that time.

units.source_text: 这歌在花街柳巷十分流行。

en.t: The song became very popular in the pleasure quarters.

units.source_text: 而且那时候内藏助裹着黑色法衣，醉熏熏的行走在祇园零落的樱花中，

en.t: And around then Kuranosuke, wrapped in a black Buddhist robe, would walk drunkenly through the falling cherry blossoms of Gion,

units.source_text: 百姓起哄的给他起了浮华公子的称号。

en.t: while the common people jeered and gave him the nickname of the frivolous young lord.

units.source_text: 《花街小景》这支歌之所以叫座儿，

en.t: There was a reason why Little Scenes of the Pleasure Quarter was such a hit,

units.source_text: 内藏助的放浪行为之所以出名，都是有道理的。

en.t: and there was also a reason why Kuranosuke's dissolute behavior became so famous.
Whether it was Yugiri, Ukihashi, or anyone else,

units.source_text: 还是岛原和撞木町的有名的太夫们，

en.t: or the famous tayu of Shimabara and Shumokumachi,

units.source_text: 只要是内藏助，就都争相奉其为座上宾。”

en.t: as long as the guest was Kuranosuke, they all competed to receive him as an honored patron.
